title: Manager Nursing - Psychiatric Adolescent
description:
Manager Nursing - Psychiatric Adolescent
Location: Oregon City, Oregon
Full-Time
We are seeking a dynamic and compassionate Nurse Manager of Clinical Operations for our Psychiatric Adolescent Unit in Oregon City, Oregon. This leader will play a pivotal role in managing the 24/7 clinical operations of the unit, driving excellence in patient care, caregiver engagement, and operational efficiency.
This role is ideal for a nurse leader with experience in behavioral health who thrives in complex, multidisciplinary environments and who values compassionate accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Provide 24/7 leadership and operational management of the adolescent psychiatric nursing unit.
  • Ensure high-quality, safe, and compassionate care is delivered in alignment with organizational standards and core values.
  • Foster a healing and wellness-focused environment for both patients and staff.
  • Lead, develop, and support a high-performing nursing team, providing coaching, mentorship, and performance management.
  • Build and sustain collaborative inter-professional relationships across departments.
  • Maintain compliance with state regulations, accreditation standards, and internal policies.
  • Manage resources wisely, including staffing, budgets, and equipment to support optimal patient outcomes.
  • Drive unit-based performance improvement and patient satisfaction initiatives.
  • Participate in strategic planning and execution in alignment with health system goals.
Required Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's Degree in Nursing (BSN)
  • Active Oregon Registered Nurse (RN) license – Required upon hire
  • BLS certification from the American Heart Association – Required upon hire
  • Minimum 5 years of clinical nursing experience with progressive leadership responsibilities
  • Strong understanding of behavioral health and adolescent psychiatric care
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Master's Degree in Nursing, Healthcare Administration, or a related field
  • Formal coursework or training in healthcare management, finance, or operations
  • National certification in psychiatric nursing or other relevant clinical specialty
  • Previous management experience in a behavioral health or acute care setting
Ideal Candidate Profile:
  • Passionate about adolescent behavioral health and dedicated to trauma-informed care
  • Demonstrated ability to build, lead, and retain high-performing nursing teams
  • Excellent clinical judgment, problem-solving, and communication skills
  • Adept at conflict resolution, team development, and interdepartmental collaboration
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic clinical environment with complex care needs
  • Committed to fostering a culture of continuous improvement and learning

title: Security Specialist Sr – HSM Authentication / Encryption Key Lifecycle
description:
Security Specialist Sr - HSM authentication / Encryption Key Lifecycle
Pittsburgh, PA
Full Time
Scheduled work from home days
2 days in office, or for emergencies so needs to be within reasonable distance

We are seeking an experienced Senior Security Specialist with hands-on expertise in Hardware Security Modules (HSMs), encryption key lifecycle management, and cryptographic solutions. This person will play a critical role in enhancing our organization's enterprise key management capabilities and contributing to our security infrastructure in a regulated environment.
Key Responsibilities
  • Serve as SME for enterprise encryption and HSMs (Thales/nShield/Cloud HSMs).
  • Implement and manage encryption key lifecycle processes: generation, storage, distribution, archival, and destruction.
  • Conduct and document key ceremonies, enforce dual control, and ensure chain of custody.
  • Perform HSM lifecycle tasks: initialization, configuration, updates, tamper handling, and decommissioning.
  • Develop and implement cryptographic policies and solutions based on business needs.
  • Maintain Secure Room infrastructure and access policies.
  • Collaborate with security, infrastructure, and application teams for key and encryption management.
  • Monitor and improve cryptographic controls based on security assessments and risk evaluations.
  • Draft SOPs, policies, and control documentation ensuring alignment with standards and regulations.
Required & Preferred Skills
Must Have:
  • Hands-on experience with Thales or nShield HSMs
  • Proficiency in encryption key lifecycle management, including key ceremonies
  • Strong knowledge of cryptographic concepts (PKI, AES, RSA, etc.)
  • Experience working in a regulated or banking environment
  • Understanding of access control, network security, and data loss prevention
  • Comfortable working in hybrid (onsite/offsite) setup
Preferred:
  • Experience with Thales CipherTrust, CKKM, Oracle Key Vault
  • Familiarity with BYOK/HYOK in AWS, Azure, or GCP
  • Exposure to scripting (Python, PowerShell)
  • Knowledge of Dynatrace, PowerBI, Jira, Confluence, and LogScale
  • Any relevant security certifications (CISSP, CISM, GIAC)

title: Virtual Design Construction (VDC) Manager
description:
VDC Manager
Location: Dallas, Texas
Full Time
We are seeking a highly skilled Virtual Design Construction (VDC) Manager to oversee BIM administration and coordination on large-scale commercial construction projects. The ideal candidate will provide both routine and advanced modeling services, facilitate 3D coordination, and support project teams with BIM-related technical expertise. This role is critical in ensuring that BIM/VDC workflows, standards, and deliverables align with the company's strategic objectives and project execution plans.
The VDC Manager will be responsible for collaborating with internal stakeholders, project managers, trade contractors, and clients to produce high-quality digital construction documentation, drive efficient BIM processes, and ensure project requirements are met or exceeded.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Manage and execute all VDC/BIM processes and coordination for assigned projects.
  • Create and maintain accurate 3D models, documentation, and digital deliverables to support design and construction teams.
  • Interpret and incorporate shop drawings, submittals, and product data into BIM workflows.
  • Lead 3D coordination meetings and facilitate clash detection and resolution using Navisworks and other tools.
  • Ensure adherence to owner requirements, BIM Execution Plans (BEP), scopes of work, and project-specific VDC protocols.
  • Assemble composite models from multiple disciplines including trade contractors and design consultants.
  • Document and track coordination issues, RFIs, and constraints throughout the BIM process.
  • Collaborate with VDC Directors and Self-Perform teams to align BIM deliverables with project objectives.
  • Maintain relationships with internal teams, owners, and subcontractors to ensure seamless VDC integration.
  • Provide technical support, training, and mentorship to project teams and junior BIM personnel.
Required Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's Degree in Architecture, Construction Management, Engineering, or related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in BIM/VDC in commercial construction.
  • Proficiency in Revit and Navisworks is mandatory.
  • Experience managing large-scale projects such as hospitals, hotels, data centers, or multi-family residential developments.
  • Strong understanding of construction documents, shop drawings, and submittals.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally in a team-oriented environment.
  • Strong organizational, coordination, and leadership capabilities.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience with additional BIM software (e.g., AutoCAD, BIM 360, Dynamo, etc.)
  • Previous involvement with design-build or self-perform construction projects
  • Familiarity with Lean Construction principles, Kaizen, and 5S
  • Experience creating or managing BIM Execution Plans (BEPs)
  • Understanding of scheduling and project controls related to VDC workflows

title: IT Lead Business Process Analyst
description:
IT Lead Business Process Analyst
Denver, Colorado (Scheduled Work From Home Days – WHQ: Work from home Monday & Friday; In-office Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday)
Full Time
We are seeking a highly experienced IT Lead Business Process Analyst to lead the design, configuration, implementation, and optimization of business software solutions, with a strong focus on SAP systems and the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) process. This individual will play a critical role in aligning IT systems with business objectives, working as a bridge between business users and technical teams to deliver high-impact solutions.
This position requires deep SAP configuration experience, particularly within P2P, and a strong ability to both lead complex projects and actively contribute to solution design alongside ABAP developers and IT team members. The role also includes mentoring and guiding junior analysts.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the development, configuration, and enhancement of SAP and other ERP systems to support business operations.
  • Serve as a key liaison between business users and IT, ensuring clear communication of requirements and solutions.
  • Manage large and complex project budgets, timelines, deliverables, and communication plans.
  • Drive continuous improvement by understanding and analyzing end-to-end business processes, especially within the procurement function.
  • Lead solution design sessions, create detailed functional specifications, and support ABAP development teams during technical implementation.
  • Design, configure, test, and manage change management for system updates and enhancements.
  • Collaborate with other business process teams to deliver integrated business solutions.
  • Provide leadership and mentorship to junior Business Process Analysts.
  • Ensure compliance with JM's established development standards and best practices.
  • Travel moderately (11–29 days/year), as required.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, or related field.
  • 7+ years of hands-on SAP (or other ERP) technical/configuration experience.
  • 7+ years of experience supporting the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) function in manufacturing or similar industry.
  • Deep configuration expertise in SAP modules supporting procurement and purchasing functions.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional IT projects from design to implementation.
  • Experience working closely with ABAP developers and participating in technical design.
  • Strong business acumen, especially in procurement and process manufacturing environments.
  • Proven ability to manage stakeholders, internal resources, and external vendors.
  • Strong communication skills—verbal, written, and negotiation.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).

Preferred/Additional Skills:

  • Exposure to SAP Ariba and Aravo tools.
  • Experience working in a process manufacturing environment.
  • Functional understanding of Adobe forms and integration in SAP projects.

title: Cyber Security Engineering Manager
description:
Cyber Security Engineering Manager
Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, United States (100% Onsite)
Full Time

Ideal Candidate Attributes:

  • Technically strong cybersecurity leader with deep vulnerability management expertise.
  • Comfortable leading hands-on technical teams and collaborating with OT stakeholders.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Must be willing and able to work onsite full-time in Pittsburgh.
We are seeking a Cyber Security Engineering & Support Manager to lead a highly visible technical team within our cybersecurity organization. This leader will oversee the deployment, lifecycle, and support of critical security technologies, manage our global vulnerability management stack, and help drive cybersecurity risk and compliance reporting.
This individual will play a key role in ensuring operational security and supporting enterprise-wide and plant-level security objectives—especially across manufacturing environments.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Lead and manage the Cybersecurity Engineering & Support team, including budgeting, personnel oversight, and solution delivery.
  • Oversee the deployment and maintenance of enterprise security technologies (endpoint, infrastructure, and cybersecurity tools).
  • Execute and evolve the company's vulnerability management strategy, ensuring continuous reduction of attack surfaces.
  • Deliver risk and compliance dashboards/KPIs/KRIs to drive data-informed decisions across cybersecurity functions.
  • Oversee IT operational security tasks such as privileged access provisioning and compliance with regulatory/internal standards.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with business units, especially OT teams (PLCs, SCADA, HMIs), to implement secure and resilient environments.
  • Report directly to the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO).
Required Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution.
  • 7+ years of experience in enterprise IT applications, infrastructure, or cybersecurity.
  • 2+ years of experience managing IT or cybersecurity professionals.
  • U.S. Citizen, lawful permanent resident, or protected individual (ITAR compliance required).
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future visa sponsorship.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Proven leadership in vulnerability management adoption and execution.
  • Experience managing a cybersecurity or IT departmental budget.
  • Prior experience securing manufacturing or operational technology environments.
  • Active security certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CISA, Security+).
  • Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems, or a related technical field.

title: Senior IT Solutions Architect – Security & Infrastructure
description:
Senior IT Solutions Architect – Security & Infrastructure
Location: Regina, Saskatchewan, Canada – 100% Onsite
Type: Full-time Contract (100% Onsite)
Contract Duration: 1 year + 2 optional one-year extensions
We're seeking an experienced IT Solutions Architect with a strong background in enterprise architecture, information security frameworks, and secure infrastructure design. This is a 100% onsite role based in Regina, focused on supporting the development, modernization, and security of critical IT systems within the Government.
The ideal candidate will have direct experience architecting solutions within government or similar public-sector environments, hands-on expertise with DevSecOps practices, and a deep understanding of formal design methodologies and security frameworks such as ISO 27001.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Lead the design and implementation of secure, scalable, and high-performance IT solutions within the GOS environment.
  • Participate in project design reviews to ensure compliance with security and infrastructure standards.
  • Collaborate with internal Solution Architects and third-party vendors to identify and implement cloud security controls, endpoint protection, and secure integration practices.
  • Analyze existing IT environments, detect deficiencies, and propose optimized solutions aligned with best practices.
  • Conduct and evaluate Threat Risk Assessments (TRAs) to support IT-related business initiatives.
  • Ensure architectural solutions address regulatory, legislative, and compliance obligations.
  • Stay abreast of emerging technologies and provide recommendations for adoption.
  • Lead or advise on critical infrastructure upgrades, legacy retirement, and secure transitions to new platforms.
  • Provide expert input into security governance, risk mitigation, and incident/problem resolution efforts.
  • Offer security advisory services for enterprise solutions, procurements, and ongoing operations.
  • Produce documentation and reports to support architecture decisions, security advisories, and technical recommendations.
  • Ensure proper stewardship of data assets, maintaining balance between access, performance, and security.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve issues efficiently during incidents or architectural conflicts.
  • Contribute to education and awareness initiatives around information security within the organization.
Mandatory Requirements:
  • Demonstrated experience as a lead IT Architect or having led major subsystems, with successful implementation of solutions.
  • Experience with formal IT design methodologies and standard frameworks for information security controls.
  • Expertise in one or more industry standard security frameworks, such as ISO 27001, NIST, or SABSA.
  • DevSecOps experience, including security automation and secure CI/CD pipelines for enterprise-grade systems.
  • Practical knowledge of multiple architecture methodologies with the ability to compare and apply them effectively.
  • Experience with cloud security, endpoint protection, network security, and secure integrations.
  • Familiarity with GOS technical and business landscape, or comparable public-sector entities (heavily weighted).
  • Demonstrated involvement as an architect through the entire solution lifecycle – from strategy to implementation and support.
  • Experience in incident and problem management, collaborating across teams to ensure resolution.
Desirable Qualifications:
  • TOGAF, SABSA, or other recognized Architecture certifications.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related technical field (or equivalent professional experience).
  • Completion of at least one formal course in project management (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2 fundamentals).
  • Prior experience working with or within Government of Saskatchewan or similar public-sector IT environments.
Key Competencies:
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proven ability to work collaboratively across teams.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, especially in explaining complex architectural solutions to business and technical audiences.
  • Self-starter who can work independently and handle multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Deep commitment to security, compliance, and continuous improvement.
